circuit:
* 2.4 GHz double-balanced Gilbert-cell downconversion mixer (Sky130)
*
* Topology
*   - RF transconductor: source-degenerated NMOS differential pair (L=0.3um,
*     RS=160 ohm per leg) on a single tail current source.  RF inputs are AC
*     coupled; the gates are re-biased from the internal bias chain.
*   - Switching quad: standard-Vt NMOS.  The LO is AC coupled through a mild
*     capacitive divider (1 pF series / 0.25 pF shunt) onto a raised gate bias,
*     so the pair keeps drain-source headroom at every PVT corner.
*   - Current bleeding: 12 kohm from VDD into each switch-pair source node
*     raises the output common mode, keeping the conducting switch saturated
*     at the LO peak (suppresses imbalance-induced fLO+fIF products at 1.62 V).
*   - Load: 2 kohm resistors to VDD, followed by a 1 kohm / 30 fF RC section
*     (plus the external 200 fF) that attenuates LO/RF feedthrough at the IF port.
*
* Bias (single external reference current, iref sinks 50 uA):
*   iref (switch-gate bias) -R1- nc (RF-gate bias) -R2- nb (reference diode)
*   The reference diode has a small source resistor RE, so the tail mirror
*   delivers a mildly CTAT current that keeps the pair's IM3 flat versus
*   temperature.

.subckt gilbert_mixer vss iref vdd lop lon rfp rfn ifoutp ifoutn

* ---- bias chain -------------------------------------------------------------

RE    nre vss 1.2k
R1    iref nc 6k
R2    nc nb 6.5k
CBYP  nb vss 1p

* ---- tail current source (7x reference) --------------------------------------
XMT   s nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=56 nf=28

* ---- degenerated RF transconductor -------------------------------------------
XM1   xp gp s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=96 nf=32
XM2   xn gn s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=96 nf=32
RS1   s1 s 160
RS2   s2 s 160
RBP   nc gp 10k
RBN   nc gn 10k
CCP   rfp gp 4p
CCN   rfn gn 4p

* ---- current bleeding into the switch-pair sources ---------------------------
RBLP  vdd xp 12k
RBLN  vdd xn 12k

* ---- LO coupling and switching quad ------------------------------------------
CLP   lop glp 1p
CLN   lon gln 1p
CLSP  glp vss 0.25p
CLSN  gln vss 0.25p
RLOP  iref glp 10k

* Ports: vss iref vdd lop lon rfp rfn ifoutp ifoutn
* iref is the only analog bias port (50 uA sink from VDD in the benches).

* --- Reference mirror input: sinks the supplied 50 uA ---
XIRE iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* --- Tail current source (mirror of iref) ---
XTAIL src iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=130 nf=13

* --- LO gate bias node: resistor-fed diode stack ---
* Series diode-connected devices give Vbias ~= 2*Vgs (~1.2 V),
* which level-shifts the 0.9 V-cm LO into a healthy quad Vgs.

XD1   vb1   vb1   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XD2   vbias vbias vb1  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* --- AC-couple LO and bias the quad gates ---
CLOP lop lopb 2p
CLON lon lonb 2p
RLOP lopb vbias 40k
RLON lonb vbias 40k

* --- RF transconductance pair with source degeneration ---
XRFP n1 rfp srcp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=24 nf=6
XRFN n2 rfn srcn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=24 nf=6
RSP  srcp src 90
RSN  srcn src 90

* --- LO switching quad (cross-coupled) ---
* n1 sources feed ndp via LO+ and ndn via LO-
* n2 sources feed ndp via LO- and ndn via LO+

XLO5 ndn lonb n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=5

RLOADN vdd ndn 1900

circuit:
* 2.4 GHz double-balanced Gilbert-cell downconversion mixer (Sky130 1.8 V core)
*
* Topology
*   - NMOS RF transconductor pair with a mirrored tail current source
*   - NMOS switching quad driven by the LO
*   - Ideal resistor loads to VDD (no PDK mismatch -> excellent output balance)
*   - RF and LO are AC coupled and re-biased internally so that the stack has
*     enough headroom at 1.62 V and at the high-Vt (ss / -40 C) corner.
*   - The single 50 uA `iref` input sets the tail current and every internal
*     bias voltage through a replica-biased branch.

.subckt gilbert_mixer vss iref vdd lop lon rfp rfn ifoutp ifoutn

*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Current reference.  50 uA is pushed into `iref` and sunk here.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMREF  iref  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4

* Tail current source: 15 x 50 uA = 750 uA
XMTAIL ntail iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=60

*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Internal bias-voltage generator (25 uA branch)
*   nlob = V(gate bias of the LO quad)
*   nrfb = V(gate bias of the RF pair) = 0.30 V + Vgs(RF replica)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBN   npd   iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMPD   npd   npd   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
XMPB   nlob  npd   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10

RLOB   nlob  nrfb  10k
XMRREP nrfb  nrfb  nrs   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=3 nf=1
RSRC   nrs   vss   12k

*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* RF input coupling / re-bias
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
CRFP   rfp   grfp  3p
CRFN   rfn   grfn  3p
RRFP   grfp  nrfb  50k
RRFN   grfn  nrfb  50k

*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* LO input coupling / re-bias
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
CLOP   lop   glop  2p
CLON   lon   glon  2p
RLOPB  glop  nlob  50k
RLONB  glon  nlob  50k

*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* RF transconductor
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMRF1  na    grfp  ntail vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=45 nf=15
XMRF2  nb    grfn  ntail vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=45 nf=15

* Tail bypass: shorts the second-order (f2-f1 and 2f) common-mode content that
* would otherwise re-mix into IM3 at the differential pair.
CTAIL  ntail vss   10p

* Drain bypass: sets the phase of the quad source nodes so that the residual
* LO common-mode (from LO phase error) no longer produces a DC term in the
* switching function -> kills RF-to-IF feedthrough.
CNA    na    vss   45f
CNB    nb    vss   45f

*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* LO switching quad
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMQ1   ifoutp glop na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XMQ2   ifoutn glon na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XMQ3   ifoutp glon nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XMQ4   ifoutn glop nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12

*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* IF load
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
RLP    vdd   ifoutp 2000
RLN    vdd   ifoutn 2000
CIFD   ifoutp ifoutn 200f

.ends gilbert_mixer

*              pair offset can no longer be chopped into LO leakage
*   XQ1/XQ2  : quad bias current sources (~200 uA each), very large W*L at the

*              (which otherwise chops bias current into LO-frequency leakage)

*              skew), cross-coupled drains

*   - RF transconductor: SVT NFETs (low Vth mismatch) sized for ~0.19 V
*     overdrive at 0.3 mA per side for linearity.
*   - LO quad: LVT NFETs (lower Vth than the SVT transconductor, which keeps
*     the transconductor in saturation during LO transitions), bulks tied to
*     their common sources.
*   - Loads: ideal resistors to vdd (ideal R/C are permitted, perfectly
*     matched, so they add no offset or feedthrough).

* Double-balanced Gilbert-cell downconversion mixer.

* feeds a 1/6.667 replica of one RF input branch through the level-shift
* resistor, so the replica generates both the RF-pair gate bias and,
* shifted up by IUP*RSHIFT, the LO switch gate common mode.  The replica
* degeneration returns to the shared tail node, so its source potential
* tracks the main branch exactly and the branch current equals the

XMPD  pdb  pdb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=10
XMPR  swb  pdb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=10

RER   sr1 s 1.44k
CGR   grp vss 5p
RUP   swb grp 3.6k
CSWB  swb vss 2p

XRF2  x2 grf2 s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
CRF1  rfp grf1 10p
CRF2  rfn grf2 10p
RGB1  grf1 grp 10k
RGB2  grf2 grp 10k
RE1   s1 s 216
RE2   s2 s 216
RT    s vss 83.721
CT    s vss 1p

* ---- LO switch quad: AC coupled, common mode from the shifted bias ----

* Double-balanced Gilbert-cell downconversion mixer.
* RF 2.3-2.5 GHz differential in, LO 200 MHz below RF, differential IF out.
* SKY130 1.8V core FETs; ideal R/C used for AC coupling, bias setting and loads.
*
* Pin order: vss iref vdd lop lon rfp rfn ifoutp ifoutn
* iref expects an external 50 uA sink reference (IREF vdd iref 50u).

.subckt gilbert_mixer vss iref vdd lop lon rfp rfn ifoutp ifoutn

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias reference
*   iref : NMOS mirror reference (diode connected, carries the 50 uA
*          external reference at the same current density as the RF
*          transconductors, so v(iref) is already the RF gate bias)
*   pd   : PMOS mirror reference
*   nbg  : RF gate bias  = v(ntb) + vgs(transconductor replica)
*   nblo : LO gate bias  = v(nls) + vgs(switch replica)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XBNB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.4 nf=2
XTAI tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=72 nf=2
XNPD pd iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.5 nf=2

* PMOS mirror reference and the two gate-bias current sources
XPDP pd pd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=4
XPBG nbg pd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=4
XPLO nblo pd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=4

* RF gate bias replica: diode connected copy of one transconductor, the
* wanted tail voltage is dropped across RTB.
XRBG nbg nbg ntb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.5 nf=2
RTB ntb vss 7.14k

* LO gate bias replica: diode connected copy of one switch, the wanted
* switch source voltage is dropped across RSL.
XRLO nblo nblo nls vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=2
RSL nls vss 20k

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Input AC coupling and gate bias resistors
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
CRP rfp nrfp 3p
CRN rfn nrfn 3p
RRP nrfp nbg 20k
RRN nrfn nbg 20k
CLP lop nlop 3p
CLN lon nlon 3p
RBP nlop nblo 20k
RBN nlon nblo 20k

* Bias node RF/LO common-mode bypass
CBG nbg vss 1p
CBLO nblo vss 2p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Gilbert core
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1 ap nrfp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=2
XM2 an nrfn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=2
XM3 ifoutp nlop ap vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=12 nf=2
XM4 ifoutn nlon ap vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=12 nf=2
XM5 ifoutn nlop an vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=12 nf=2
XM6 ifoutp nlon an vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=12 nf=2

CTAIL tail vss 2p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Differential load resistors (set the output common mode and IF gain)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------

circuit:
* Double-balanced Gilbert-cell downconversion mixer, 2.4 GHz RF -> 200 MHz IF.
*
* Pin description:
*   vss     ground
*   iref    50 uA reference current input (only analog bias port)
*   vdd     supply
*   lop/lon differential LO inputs (50 ohm per side, 0.9 V common mode)
*   rfp/rfn differential RF inputs (50 ohm per side, 0.9 V common mode)
*   ifoutp/ifoutn differential IF outputs (200 fF load per side)
*
* Architecture:
*   - The 50 uA reference flows through RREF and diode MREF. The MREF gate
*     (refg) drives the tail current mirror; the iref node sits one RREF
*     drop higher and biases the AC-coupled RF-pair gates (RBIP/RBIN,
*     CINP/CINN), decoupling the pair source voltage from the 0.9 V pin
*     common mode so the tail current source stays saturated at all PVT.
*   - M1/M2 form the source-degenerated RF transconductor.
*   - M3-M6 form the lvt switching quad, cross-coupled to the LO.
*   - RLP/RLN set the output common mode; CBIAS/CTAIL bypass the bias and
*     tail nodes.

.subckt gilbert_mixer vss iref vdd lop lon rfp rfn ifoutp ifoutn

* Reference chain: iref -> RREF -> diode MREF -> vss.
XMREF refg refg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
RREF iref refg 5.6k
CBIAS iref vss 100p

* Tail current source mirrored from the reference (14 x 50 uA).
XMTAIL tail refg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=336 nf=84

* AC-coupled RF inputs; gates biased from the iref node.
CINP rfp gp 2p
CINN rfn gn 2p
RBIP gp iref 1k
RBIN gn iref 1k

* Degenerated differential RF transconductor.
XM1 na gp s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=16
XM2 nb gn s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=16
RDEG1 s1 tail 270
RDEG2 s2 tail 270
CTAIL tail vss 100p

* LO switching quad (cross-coupled).
XM3 ifoutp lon na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=80 nf=16
XM4 ifoutn lop na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=80 nf=16
XM5 ifoutn lon nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=80 nf=16
XM6 ifoutp lop nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=80 nf=16

* IF load resistors.
RLP vdd ifoutp 3.0k
RLN vdd ifoutn 3.0k

.ends gilbert_mixer

circuit:
* 2.4 GHz double-balanced Gilbert-cell downconversion mixer
* Single bias port: iref (50 uA reference current forced externally)
*
* Shared-tail NMOS Gilbert cell.
*   iref  -> terminated (draws the forced 50 uA).
*   RTAIL holds the RF-pair tail close to vss so the pair (gates biased at
*   0.9 V CM by the testbench) conducts; NMOS bulk is tied to the local
*   source (tail) to cancel body effect, which otherwise starves the pair.
*   PMOS cross-coupled LO switching quad: source = RF drain, drain = output,
*   so the 0.55-1.25 V LO swing can toggle the switches; ideal resistor
*   loads to vdd set output DC and conversion gain.
.subckt gilbert_mixer vss iref vdd lop lon rfp rfn ifoutp ifoutn
RREF iref vss 10k
RTAIL tail vss 1k
*
* RF transconductance pair: drains d1/d2, sources at tail node.
* Bulk tied to source (tail) to cancel body effect.
XMRP rfp d1 tail tail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=6
XMRN rfn d2 tail tail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=6
*
* PMOS cross-coupled LO switching quad: drain = output, source = RF drain.
XMP1 ifoutp lon d1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=8
XMP2 ifoutp lop d2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=8
XMP3 ifoutn lop d1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=8
XMP4 ifoutn lon d2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=8
*
* Ideal resistor loads to VDD set output DC and conversion gain.
RLP ifoutp vdd 1.5k
RLN ifoutn vdd 1.5k
.ends gilbert_mixer

circuit:
* 2.4 GHz double-balanced Gilbert-cell downconversion mixer, Sky130.
* Single 50 uA reference input (iref); differential 200 MHz IF output.
*
* Topology:
*  - Source-degenerated NMOS current mirror scales the iref reference to the
*    mixer tail current (ratio set by ideal resistors R_A/R_B, 800 uA).
*  - LVT differential RF transconductor pair (gates rfp/rfn).
*  - LVT LO switching quad: minimum channel length and low Vt give fast,
*    sharp commutation, which suppresses deterministic RF feedthrough under
*    LO amplitude/phase imbalance; large width keeps switch mismatch small.
*  - Ideal load resistors set the conversion gain and output common mode.
*  - Tail-bypass capacitor RF-grounds the tail node (sized for settling
*    within the measurement window).

.subckt gilbert_mixer vss iref vdd lop lon rfp rfn ifoutp ifoutn

* --- Bias: degenerated mirror, I_tail = 50u * R_A/R_B = 800uA nominal. ---
XMREF iref iref ra vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=11.25 nf=2
RA ra vss 1300
XMTAIL tail iref rb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=90 nf=15
RB rb vss 62.5

* --- RF transconductor pair (LVT; area sized for Vt-mismatch vs LO-IF). ---
XM1 na rfp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=42 nf=6
XM2 nb rfn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=42 nf=6

* --- LO switching quad: fast (LVT, Lmin) and large (low mismatch). ---
XM3 ifoutp lop na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=84 nf=12
XM4 ifoutn lop nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=84 nf=12
XM5 ifoutp lon nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=84 nf=12
XM6 ifoutn lon na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=84 nf=12

* --- Load resistors (ideal, perfectly matched). ---
RLP vdd ifoutp 1800
RLN vdd ifoutn 1800

* --- Tail RF bypass. ---
CTAIL tail vss 12p

.ends gilbert_mixer
